Note:
"Bunzl" is a major international distribution and outsourcing company
, not a primary manufacturer of medical or wearable consumer health devices like continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) or smartwatches. Devices in these categories are instead produced by specialized medical and tech companies.
Overview of Wearables and Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Wearable arm sensors (e.g., Abbott FreeStyle Libre, Dexcom) that track interstitial fluid glucose levels 24/7 without routine finger pricks.
NetMeds Healthcare
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:
Wrist-based devices (e.g., Apple Watch, Samsung Galaxy Watch) that feature optical PPG sensors for heart rate/oxygen and electrical sensors for single-lead ECG recordings.
Amazon.in
Sleep Trackers:
Dedicated bands, rings (e.g., Oura), or smartwatches that analyze sleep stages, duration, and recovery metrics.
Amazon.in
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
A digital health framework where connected medical hardware automatically transmits patient vitals (blood pressure, glucose, ECG) to cloud platforms and clinical care teams.
